Retained Wikipedia Russian alphabet oldid1371795481, catalog/sources/units-26-30/wikipedia/russian-alphabet-1371795481.txt: complete Letters table heading and А/Б/В rows, selecting the modern Russian Name field separately from obsolete Old Church Slavonic word-names, English respellings, approximate sound comparisons and example translations. Retained Wikipedia Russian grammar oldid1369617627, catalog/sources/units-26-30/wikipedia/russian-grammar-1369617627.txt: complete Indeclinable nouns section, specifically the supplied USSR masculine and USA plural examples and unchanged case treatment. Both CC BY-SA4.0 through retained Wikipedia:Copyrights oldid1369466282 rights attestation; stable primary URLs and contributor attribution preserved. English contexts ask about naming a shown glyph or interpreting a supplied initialism as a noun in a sentence/adjective agreement context. No Russian sentence is invented. The supplied names and initialisms are literal native selections; naming by text does not demonstrate listening, pronunciation or the complete phonetic foundation. Six former literal reference questions remain optional SOURCE_QUESTION practice on a non-gating GUIDANCE objective. Their correct keys follow the literal prompts and are preserved; table/heading recall does not clear the language objectives. Independently authored English on 2026-10-13 within content-audit-2026-10-08; no copied explanatory primary prose or private Penguin text; qualified source/rights/semantic audit pending.
